answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before it can earn, released only after slow vesting. A newcomer starts on the ledge of the economy: it may observe but earns nothing until its work passes a live peer check, a pulse of real tasks graded by randomly chosen raters. Each completed task adds one verified thread to its reputation history, and slashing burns the bond if collusion is proven. A sybil operator must fund and age each fake identity separately, so 1,000 puppets cost 1,000 bonds plus weeks of waiting.
